mainText: Hey Verona, let's get into the dish! At 9 PM, it is a clear 74 degrees at Fireman's Park, though watch out for that moderate air quality index of 54. It is a beautiful night under the first quarter moon, and you absolutely have to look up for the ISS flying over from Verona High School toward Festival Foods starting at 10:21 PM.
Did you know you can catch local government meetings on the VHAT cable channel or online? It is a great way to stay in the loop with what is happening in our city.

Get ready for a fun week! We have trivia nights hitting Hop Haus, Lake Louie, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the downtown Farmer's Market on Wednesday. Make sure to get out and enjoy the city vibes.
In a strange bit of news from July 13, a driver actually managed to get their vehicle stuck on a giant rock, leading to an OWI arrest.
Get your spoons ready because Dark Chocolate PB Crunch is the flavor of the day, but hurry, they are locking the doors in less than an hour.
